Prepare!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 16 (Formerly, [[Headache Headquarters]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Megatron Toilet''' was a high health enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Slow Boss]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every modern [[Slow Boss]] variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It aws the second [[Boss]] that the player encounters and has very high health topped off with defense which can melted away by specific towers. Unlike its regular counterpart it is slightly faster and much tougher. Additionally, when it first spawns it was a [[Boss]], making it harder to stall, prevent it from having its defense reduced and cause it to no longer receive damage from the [[Nuke]]'s fallout damage. ==Appearance== The '''Megatron Toilet''' has pale skin and black hair. It wears a red aloha shirt, blue pants and brown shoes. Its torso is replaced by a giant toilet, out of which its head comes out. The toilet is grey and dirty. It has six fans on its back. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *Defense dropping towers, like the [[Cryomancer]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] or [[Pyromancer]] can be useful at dropping its defense. **Defense dropping towers that can also slow down enemies, like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Cryomancer]] and [[Freezer]] can also be very useful at slowing it down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} MegatronToilet.png|First version (1 April 2024 – 4 August 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MegatronToilet.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseMegatronToilet.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (4 August 2025 – Present) CorpseQuagmire.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, first version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – 4 August 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} MegatronToiletIconIG.png|'''Megatron Toilet''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Megatron Toilet''' is based on [[w:c:familyguy:Glenn Quagmire|Glenn Quagmire]] from ''Family Guy'', though with a giant toilet in its torso. **This may be a reference to a meme where [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jbvk2rQa8wo he turns into a toilet]. *The name itself could possibly reference Megatron from the ''Transformer'' series. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' -
